in_marathi.name: Dheeman
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dheeman हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dhee’ meaning ‘wisdom’ and ‘manas’ meaning ‘mind’. The name Dheeman signifies a powerful and radiant mind. In Hindu mythology, Dheeman is also the name of a sage who attained immense wisdom and spiritual power.
